title: Basie on remembering everything and what he will keep out of his book
summary: Basie says he remembers everything that ever happened to him and that there are things he would not put in his book.

blocks.x: Okay. Katy Krippen. I mean, all that history's lost, you know, unless you remember it. It's --
Yeah, but I can -- you know, I could pretty well remember everything. I can pretty much remember everything that happened to me from the beginning of anything, almost beginning of me.
Really? And you just never wanted to talk about it.

I know everything that ever happened to me, everything. There's nothing that I have forgotten. Because I lived every bit of that. I lived with every bit of that -- I have knowledge on everything, life, everything, when I was a little-bitty boy, because I've always been interested in life as it is.
Is there anything that you would not put in your book, for example?

There are several things what I wouldn't put in the book (inaudible) be selling, people would buy it for, you know. People buy things for what's in it, that (inaudible).
